findings.F1: On the plan's own 1920 cases (725 days), the unusual move reaches the bar at shorter horizons and fades at longer ones: +0.62 % with t 2.14 over 3 days, +0.87 % with t 2.14 over 5 days, +1.26 % with t 1.88 over 10 days, +1.94 % with t 1.74 over 20 days (1746 cases, 666 days), and the strength falls from 0.072 to 0.064, so the 10-day test sits just past where the effect shows clearly.
findings.F2: The streak's grading shows at 5 days and nowhere else. On the plan's cases the unusual move rises from the bottom to the top forecast third over 5 days (+0.50 %, +0.82 %, +1.30 %; top third t 1.98, 342 days). It is flat over 3 days (+0.70 %, +0.56 %, +0.61 %) and over 10 days (+1.24 %, +1.25 %, +1.29 %), and reversed over 20 days (+2.78 % against +0.69 %). The 10-day supporting check passed by only +0.05 %.
findings.F3: Most of the effect comes from the size of the 30-day return rather than from the streak. On the plan's cases, the top 30-day-return third earns +1.93 % over 3 days (t 3.22, 230 days), +2.07 % over 5 days (t 2.53) and +2.43 % over 10 days (t 1.97). The bottom third earns −0.19 %, −0.01 % and +0.93 %. Over 5 days the top-minus-bottom difference is +1.58 % (Welch t 2.69, on a 5-day case grid).
findings.F4: On 5-day grid bars with a positive 30-day return, signal and no-signal bars move alike within each 30-day-return third: top third +1.38 % with a streak against +1.31 % without (354 to 428 cases each). The no-signal bars alone rise with the 30-day return: −1.21 %, +0.08 %, +1.31 % across the thirds.
findings.F5: The effect is mixed across years and coins, which keeps its t under 2. The 10-day unusual move is −6.1 % in 2018, −2.95 % in 2022 and −0.36 % in 2025, against +3.7 % to +4.7 % in 2020–2021 and +1.9 % to +2.9 % in 2023–2024. Only 47 % of cases are positive (median −0.93 %), and BTC, LTC, XMR, TRX, UNI and NEAR are each near 0 (|t| < 0.5).

ideas.idea: The more days in a row a coin has closed higher, measured against the lengths of its own up-close streaks over the past 365 days, the more it keeps rising over the next 5 days, only while its 30-day return is positive.
ideas.consequence: A trader would hold a long taken on an unusually long up streak in a rising month for about five days, where the continuation is clearest and still grows with the streak, rather than ten.
ideas.name: up-streak continuation over 5 days

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's 30-day return, the more it keeps rising over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would lean long a coin in proportion to how strongly it has risen over the past month, and refuse longs in coins whose month has been weak, whether or not it is on an up streak.
ideas.name: 30-day return continuation
